four_defects_found_by_running.symptom: with niter==1 every case exactly correct; with niter>1 EVERY iteration after the first wrong, deterministically at the same rows, only row 0 surviving
four_defects_found_by_running.cause: carrying m/l/acc across outer persistent-loop iterations is not correct in this emission
four_defects_found_by_running.fix: establish gamma/w residency INSIDE the token-group iteration (p503_persist / kernel_persist); verified niter=2,3,4 at P=64/56/32/43 and 20/20 official cases at P=32
four_defects_found_by_running.status: CORRECTED -- ROOT CAUSE FOUND UNDER G51
four_defects_found_by_running.original_diagnosis: carrying m/l/acc across outer persistent-loop iterations is not correct in this emission
four_defects_found_by_running.corrected_diagnosis: the m/l/acc state carry was ALWAYS correct. What goes stale is the RESIDENT gamma/w staging filled before the persistent loop: a shared (UB) buffer written before a T.Pipelined loop does not hold its contents in later iterations. Re-establishing residency INSIDE the iteration fixes it, and the persistent g += P schedule then passes 20/20 official cases.
how_established: two reducers over the SAME quantity in one region PASS -> the second reducer was never the cause
second reducer reading g_ub FAILS, reading w_ub PASSES -> g_ub is the FIRST buffer written before the loop, so the LEADING residency region is what goes stale
g_ub staged into a fragment before reducing STILL FAILS -> it is g_ub's VALUE, not how it is read
residency re-established every iteration PASSES; residency kept with versions pinned to 1 FAILS -> it is loop-carried residency, not buffer versioning

four_defects_found_by_running.symptom: D=2047 and D=1000 fail 'no available layout found'
four_defects_found_by_running.cause: layout inference refuses a shared buffer whose extent is not a power of two
four_defects_found_by_running.fix: UB padded to next_power_of_2(D); every producer writes only i<D and every reduction masks i<D

four_defects_found_by_running.cause: copies moved D elements into a PD-element buffer
four_defects_found_by_running.fix: region copies touch exactly D elements of the padded buffer (the verified RMSNorm example's own pattern)
